ability.name: Short-tempered
ability.effect: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly **^^Skaven^^** units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.

ability.name: Scurry Away
ability.effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

ability.name: Skilled Manipulator
ability.effect:
While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly non-**^^Hero Skaven Infantry^^** unit:
• This unit has **^^Ward (4+)^^**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly non-**^^Hero Skaven Infantry^^** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

ability.name: Fleshmeddler
ability.effect: Pick 1 of the target’s melee weapons. Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the turn.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Moulder^^** unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.

ability.name: Devious Underling
ability.effect:
For the rest of the battle:
• While the target has not been slain, friendly **^^Skaven Infantry^^** units have **^^Ward (6+)^^** while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
• Once the target has been slain, add 2 to charge rolls for friendly **^^Skaven Infantry^^** units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
ability.declare: Pick another friendly **^^Skaven Hero^^** on the battlefield with a Health characteristic that equals or exceeds this unit’s Health characteristic to be the target.

ability.name: Pit Tinkerer
ability.effect: You can re-roll the random characteristic rolls for the Move characteristic of friendly **^^Skryre War Machines^^** while they are wholly within 13" of this unit. In addition, each time a friendly **^^Skryre War Machine^^** wholly within 18" of this unit uses the ‘Rolling Doom’ or ‘Whirling Doom’ ability, add 1 to the amount of mortal damage inflicted, if any.
